rationale: Buggy contiguous slice gives each worker a num_workers-wide window starting at worker_id, so leftover indices overlap and miss; fix uses strided slicing. Both versions return a valid (possibly empty) array and downstream collator never raises, so training silently duplicates/drops samples. Detection requires inspecting the per-worker leftover index sets across workers and checking union==full set — not in Tier 0-6 schema (dataloader internals). Per anti-example 9, source-only/dataloader-internal bugs are pattern=none, layer=none, tier=exceeds_tier6. parallel_dim=FSDP per OLMo+FSDP convention.
